mapper.select: SELECT call_id FROM rtc_call WHERE state IN ('RINGING', 'ACCEPTED', 'CONNECTED') AND expires_at <= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 5 SECOND) AND (state = 'RINGING' OR JSON_SEARCH(COALESCE(participant_states, '{}'), 'one', 'INVITED') IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY expires_at, call_id LIMIT #{limit}
